title: Launch stability gates and success-signal runbook for customer pilot
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Orchestrate a safe, observable, and measurable pilot launch for 6 lighthouse customers in EU-West. This ticket establishes the stability gates, success signals, cross-team responsibilities, and the release-notes/communications cadence required for sign-off at each phase. Scope includes: launch checklist for PM/Eng/Design/CS, coordinated release notes and customer comms, preflight runbook for reliability smoke tests, and a feedback loop with nightly digest for the first 2 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot health dashboard live with payload/latency/error breakdowns and customer-specific filters
All release notes drafts (public and customer-specific) reviewed and approved by legal & support at least 48 hours prior to each pilot wave
Stability gates defined and automated: smoke tests, latency p95 <= 220ms, error rate < 0.5% sustained over 1 hour
Lighthouse customers have onboarding artifacts + runbook and have completed at least one integration test with a Redwood engineer present
Feedback ingestion pipeline connected to a triage board (Linear) and nightly summary emails sent to stakeholders for first 14 days
Rollback criteria documented and tested (automated feature flag toggle and fallback model routing validated)
tasks: Create pilot launch checklist (PM) with timeboxed gates and approvals (Due: 2025-03-05)
Ship pilot health dashboard (ENG) including token-level cost, latency, and errors per customer (Due: 2025-03-08)
Draft release notes: public, partner, and per-customer variants (PM + Legal + CS) (Due: 2025-03-10)
Design onboarding kit and sample integration snippets for customers (DES) (Due: 2025-03-06)
Run preflight reliability test (ENG): sustained load for 2 hours at 2x expected traffic (Due: 2025-03-12)
Schedule customer kickoff calls and technical walkthroughs (CS/PM) (Start: 2025-03-13)
Create nightly feedback digest automation and Linear triage templates (PM/ENG) (Due: 2025-03-13)
Coordinate on-call rotation and escalation matrix for pilot (SRE + Support) (Due: 2025-03-10)
Prepare rollback drills and validate fallback to hosted-compatible model variants (ENG) (Due: 2025-03-14)
risks: Unexpected performance regression from recent kernel selection changes could increase p95 latency
Late-staged release-note edits from legal could delay customer communications
One or more lighthouse accounts may depend on Private/VPC features not yet fully validated in EU-West
Observability gaps for KV cache warm-up could mask transient errors during ramp
assumptions: Core serving change in runtime-1.18 will not be deployed to pilot cluster without separate ENG sign-off
Lighthouse customers have a technical contact and can onboard within a 2-week window
Sufficient Dedicated capacity reserved for pilot waves to meet peak throughput needs
communication_plan: Weekly cross-functional sync (Mon 09:30 CET) during pre-launch
Daily standup channel (#pilot-euw) for first 7 days of each wave
Nightly digest email (automated) with top issues and triage status to stakeholders 18:00 CET
Customer-facing status page updates for scheduled windows and incidents
release_notes_plan: Prepare three artifacts: public release notes, customer-specific technical notes (integration steps), and internal ops runbook
PM to finalize bullets -> Legal review -> CS tailoring -> Publish (48h approval SLA)
Pin release notes version and link in pilot onboarding kit and health dashboard
rollout_phases: Phase 0 (Canary): internal partners + 1 lighthouse account for 48h (goal: validate integrations)
Phase 1 (Wave A): 2 lighthouse accounts for 72h with ops on-call and extended telemetry
Phase 2 (Wave B): remaining 3 lighthouse accounts + broader beta invite list (ramp to target throughput)
Phase 3 (Open Beta): open sign-ups gated on meeting quality and stability signals
metrics_and_signals: Primary: p95 latency, request success rate, tokens/sec per customer
Secondary: prefix cache hit rate, cost-per-token (rolling hourly), median tail latency
Customer signals: successful integration test, NPS for onboarding, CS tickets opened in first 14 days
Automated SLO alerts and severity levels configured in OpsGenie
